title: The cognitive, affective, and behavioral expression of self-stigma among people who use drugs in online substance use communities
reasoning: The study employs LLMs to classify self-stigma indicators in social media text. While it defines 'Guilt/Self-Blame' in the codebook as 'sadness... with moral self-blame', this is used purely as a linguistic indicator of internalized stigma rather than a study or benchmark of moral reasoning, ethics, or religion.
